title: VIX futures & options January expiration (SOQ settlement)
source: EST: www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after one 301, 1,731 bytes), fetched direct 2026-09-06 by the opex-2027-01-15 adjacency sweep and parsed into all 42 contract rows. Two rows on that one file date this settlement DIRECTLY, not by inference: `VX,VX/F7,2027-01-20,19.9997` and `VXM,VXM/F7,2027-01-20,19.9997` — a live daily settlement price against an expiration dated 2027-01-20 itself, on both the standard and the Mini root. Arithmetic cross-check, computed independently: 2027-01-20 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2027-02-19, February's third Friday, matching the VX contract terms that reproduce on all 14 listed VX rows once NYSE closures (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched the same session) are applied. That is the same two-surface standard by which vix-expiration-2027-02-17 was promoted, minus one leg: this session read the CSV but did NOT independently re-fetch the HTML settlement page, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. notes: PROPOSED by the opex-2027-01-15 initial research (2026-09-06), INSIDE its +/-5-day adjacency corridor at exactly +5 days. This calendar already tracks the VIX settlement run at 2026-09-16, 2027-02-17, 2027-03-17, 2027-04-21 and 2027-05-18; January 2027 was the hole, and the proposer's own corridor is where it surfaced. WHAT IT IS: VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW expiration exactly 30 days out. VX/F7's reference series is therefore 2027-02-19 — February's monthly expiration (opex-2027-02-19, estimate) — and NOT the 2027-01-15 expiration this settlement follows. THE STRUCTURAL PLACEMENT WORTH TRACKING, and the reason this is not a bare hole-fill: among listed VIX futures, VX/F7 is the JANUARY-FOMC line and its predecessor is not. VX/Z6 (settles 2026-12-16, listed on the same file at 18.975) carries the strip 2026-12-17 -> 2027-01-15, which ends eleven days BEFORE the 2027-01-26/27 decision and is instead the contract whose reference series IS the proposer's own expiration. VX/F7 carries 2027-01-21 -> 2027-02-19, which CONTAINS the decision at day 7 of 30. Two consequences. (1) A VIX future's price is an expectation of its own VRO, so January-FOMC volatility can be carried by VX/F7 and cannot be carried by VX/Z6 — a placement that prevents a wrong instrument choice and recommends none. (2) Day 7 of 30 is the inverse of the February/March pair the vix-expiration-2027-02-17 ledger analysed, where the decision sits at day 27 of 30 and is heavily diluted by the strip that follows it. Also worth recording exactly: the five days 2027-01-16 -> 2027-01-20 fall in NEITHER contract's strip, so consecutive VIX settlements do not tile the calendar and a later session should not assume they do. This settlement also falls INSIDE the FOMC communications blackout (2027-01-16 -> 2027-01-28) and INSIDE the proposer's own five-session post-expiration window (2027-01-19 -> 2027-01-25), which is a named contaminant in FT-opex-2027-01-15-1. Impact LOW, matching every sibling in this run: it widens caution and supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-01-20 opening auction), and it licenses nothing. SECOND HOLE, NAMED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED HERE: vix-expiration-2026-12-16 is equally untracked and equally directly dated on the same file (`VX,VX/Z6,2026-12-16,18.975`), but at 101 days out it sits far outside this proposer's corridor and is the vix-expiration lane's to file, not this one's — recorded here so it is captured rather than lost. Every date named above is estimate and nothing here is tradeable.
